english.note: Use this when the risky speculation specifically involves buying and selling shares, property, or other assets for profit.

examples.english: Even with property prices so volatile, some people still borrow money to speculate in uncompleted flats.
examples.traditional: 而家樓價咁波動，仲有人借錢炒賣樓花。
